meta.description: Nyochaa ọgwụ gị, nụrụ otu esi aṅụ ya n'asụsụ gị, ma nweta ncheta mgbe oge ruru.

header.readAloudUnavailable: Ịgụpụta n'olu adịghị na ihe nchọgharị a ugbu a.
header.voiceMissing: Ngwaọrụ a enweghị olu {language} ugbu a. Gụọ kaadị ahụ, ma ọ bụ jụọ onye na-ahụ maka ọgwụ gị.

landing.lead: Nyochaa akara ọgwụ ma nụrụ ya n'Igbo, Yoruba, Hausa, Pidgin ma ọ bụ Bekee. Nweta ncheta n'ekwentị ọ bụla. Onye ọgwụ gị na-ahụ mgbe ị chọrọ enyemaka.
landing.previewLabel: Ngosi dị ndụ · Otu ọgwụ, asụsụ ise
landing.previewVoiceMissing: Ngwaọrụ a enwebeghị olu {language}. Gụọ ahịrịokwu ahụ kama.
landing.howTitle: Site n'ụlọ ahịa ọgwụ ruo n'ọgwụ ziri ezi n'ụlọ
landing.howIntro: Usoro anọ, ọ dịghị ọgụgụ a chọrọ. Usoro ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ na-enweghị ịntanetị ma na-adaba na SMS.
landing.step1Body: Tụọ igwefoto n'akara ma ọ bụ ndenye ọgwụ. AI na-agụ ọgwụ, ọnụọgụ na nọmba NAFDAC.
landing.step2Body: A na-ekwu ntuziaka n'asụsụ gị, n'okwu doro anya.
landing.step3Body: Ncheta site na ngwa, SMS ma ọ bụ oku olu. A na-agwa ndị nlekọta ma ọ bụrụ na ọgwụ efuo.
landing.step4Body: Okwu ize ndụ dị ka “mgbu obi” na-agwa onye ọgwụ gị ma gosi ụlọ ọgwụ kacha nso.
landing.viewsIntro: Ụlọ ọgwụ ọ bụla nwere oghere nke ya enyochara. A na-enyocha ndị ọrụ na ndị ọrịa site n'akụkọ ụlọ ọgwụ.
landing.viewsPatientsDoes: Nyochaa, gee ntị, jụọ n'olu, debanye
landing.viewsStaffSees: Ihe egwu nnabata, ọkwa, mmetụta ọgwụ
landing.viewsStaffVerified: ID ndị ọrụ + MDCN / PCN / NMCN
landing.viewsHospitalsSees: Ndị ọrụ, ndị ọrịa, nkwenye, mbufe
landing.phoneTitle: Enweghị smartphone? Enweghị data? Ka a na-ekpuchi gị.
landing.phoneBody: Ncheta na-abịa site na SMS ma ọ bụ oku olu. Zaghachi 1 mgbe ị ṅụchara ya. Ngwa a na-arụkwa ọrụ na-enweghị ịntanetị ma mekọrịta ma emechaa.
landing.phoneSms: 08:00 Mama Nkechi, ṅụọ Lisinopril 10mg ugbu a. Zaghachi 1 ma ị ṅụọla, 2 ma ị ṅụbeghị.
landing.phoneFigure: Ekwentị nkịtị na-egosi ncheta SMS na nzaghachi “1”.
landing.safeIntro: AI na-akọwa ma na-echetara. Mkpebi na-anọ n'aka ndị ọkachamara nwere ikike.
landing.safe1Body: Ọ dịghị ndenye ọgwụ, ọ dịghị mgbanwe ọnụọgụ. Ajụjụ na-edoghị anya na-aga n'aka onye ọgwụ gị.
landing.safe2Body: A na-ejide okwu mberede tupu AI ọ bụla arụọ ọrụ.
landing.safe3Body: Nkwenye bụ mbụ, akụkọ ezoro ezo, budata ma ọ bụ hichapụ data gị.
landing.safe4Body: Ozi ọgbakọ naanị site n'aka ndị ọkachamara MDCN, PCN na NMCN nwere ikike.
landing.ctaTitle: Hụ ka ọ na-arụ ọrụ n'ihe na-erughị otu nkeji.
landing.ctaBody: Họrọ ọrụ: onye ọrịa, onye ọgwụ ma ọ bụ onye nchịkwa ụlọ ọgwụ.
landing.previewAudioSoon: Olu asụsụ a na-abịa. Gụọ ahịrịokwu ahụ ugbu a.
